instructions.name: assign_device
docs: Assign a device to a shipment. Creates an immutable DeviceAssignment
PDA, preserving the device's full assignment history. Rejected if the
shipment is closed.

instructions.name: attest_shipment_verification
docs: Record an off-chain verification attestation against a closed shipment.
Additive and multi-party: any signer may attest, and a shipment may
accrue several attestations from distinct verifiers (up to
`Shipment::MAX_ATTESTATIONS`). The attestation pins to the shipment's
`chain_hash` at verification time and is stored inline on the Shipment
PDA so verification status is readable in a single account fetch.

accounts.name: verifier
docs: The verifier — anyone may attest. Authorization at the attestation-trust
level is an off-chain concern (downstream consumers decide which
verifier pubkeys they trust).

accounts.name: instructions_sysvar
docs: signature verification of the attestation payload (see handler TODO).
Constrained by address so the layout is stable for the hardened path.

instructions.name: close_shipment
docs: Dissolve the shipment subnet. Operator-only, one-way. After close, no
new dispatches or assignments are accepted.

accounts.name: shipment
docs: Operator-only, one-way. The `has_one = authority` constraint ensures
only the wallet that founded the shipment can dissolve it.

instructions.name: create_shipment
docs: Found a shipment subnet. `nonce` is a 32-byte unguessable identifier;
`manifest_commitment` binds the off-chain shipment manifest.

instructions.name: end_assignment
docs: Mark the device's current assignment as ended. Permitted regardless of
shipment closed state, so devices can be freed for reuse.

instructions.name: register_device
docs: Register a new device. Creates an immutable PDA keyed by device_id.

instructions.name: submit_proof
docs: Submit a consensus dispatch commitment against an active assignment.
The submitter must be the device's recorded hardware-rooted authority.
No account is created; the Shipment PDA is updated and the dispatch is
emitted to the transaction log.

accounts.name: device
docs: The registered device this dispatch is submitted under. Its recorded
authority must be the transaction signer (hardware-rooted identity).

accounts.name: submitter
docs: Must be the device's recorded authority key. This is the
hardware-rooted identity check: only the registered device's owner
can submit dispatches under its assignment.

errors.name: DeviceAlreadyAssigned
errors.msg: Device is already assigned to a shipment

errors.name: AssignmentMismatch
errors.msg: Assignment account does not match device's current assignment

errors.name: ShipmentClosed
errors.msg: Shipment is closed and cannot accept new operations

errors.name: UnauthorizedSubmitter
errors.msg: Submitter is not the authority of the device referenced by the assignment

errors.name: AssignmentDeviceMismatch
errors.msg: Assignment's device field does not match the provided device account

errors.name: AssignmentEnded
errors.msg: Assignment has been ended; cannot submit proofs against it

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Unauthorized: signer does not match the required authority

errors.name: ShipmentNotClosed
errors.msg: Shipment must be closed before it can be attested

errors.name: AttestationCapacityExceeded
errors.msg: Shipment has reached its maximum attestation capacity

fields.name: device
docs: Device that was assigned.

fields.name: shipment
docs: Shipment it was assigned to.

fields.name: sequence
docs: Sequence number (0 = first assignment for this device).

fields.name: authority
docs: Authority that created the assignment.

fields.name: assigned_at
docs: Unix timestamp of assignment.

fields.name: ended_at
docs: Unix timestamp of unassignment. 0 if still active.

fields.name: proof_count
docs: Number of proofs submitted against this assignment. Maintained for
off-chain per-assignment accounting; not used as a PDA seed.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: authority
docs: Owner authorized to assign this device and submit proofs.

fields.name: device_id
docs: Hardware-derived device ID (ATECC608 serial in bytes [0..9]).

fields.name: pubkey
docs: ATECC608 P-256 public key, compressed SEC1 format.
Layout: prefix byte (0x02 or 0x03) + 32-byte X coordinate.

fields.name: assignment_count
docs: Total assignments this device has had. Also serves as next sequence.

fields.name: current_assignment
docs: Current active assignment PDA, or Pubkey::default() if unassigned.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for re-derivation.

types.name: ProofSubmitted
docs: Emitted by `submit_proof`. The per-round audit record — a subnet member's
consensus dispatch — lives in the transaction log permanently. Solana
blockTime (via getTransaction) is the authoritative chain-witnessed
timestamp; not duplicated here.

fields.name: sequence
docs: Chain-assigned sequence within this shipment. 0 for the first proof.

fields.name: commitment
docs: 32-byte hash binding the off-chain consensus dispatch content.

fields.name: chain_hash_after
docs: The shipment's integrity hash chain value AFTER folding in this proof.
Lets off-chain consumers verify chain progression from event data alone,
without a separate account fetch.

types.name: Shipment
docs: A Shipment is the on-chain bracketing of an EQS (Ephemeral Quorum Subnet)
— the permissioned cluster of sensors monitoring one cargo shipment.
The chain records when the subnet formed (create_shipment), the stream of
consensus dispatches it produced (submit_proof), and when it was dissolved
(close_shipment). The chain does not arbitrate the subnet's internal
consensus protocol — that is the subnet's own business, verifiable by
parties holding the operator's off-chain manifest.

fields.name: authority
docs: Operator wallet that founded this shipment subnet. Authorized to
assign devices and to close the subnet. May be a per-shipment fresh
keypair (recommended) to break correlation between the operator's
real-world identity and their on-chain shipment history.

fields.name: nonce
docs: 32-byte unguessable shipment identifier chosen by the operator.
Stored opaquely so an observer who knows `authority` cannot enumerate
the operator's shipments by guessing sequential nonces.

fields.name: manifest_commitment
docs: 32-byte hash binding the off-chain shipment manifest (route,
temperature range, deadlines, lot numbers, quorum policy, expected
cluster identifiers). The manifest itself lives off-chain under
operator control; this commitment makes it tamper-evident.

fields.name: proof_count
docs: Total consensus dispatches anchored to this shipment. Chain-assigned
sequence source; incremented on each accepted proof.

fields.name: last_commitment
docs: 32-byte commitment from the most recent dispatch. Lets an observer
read the latest anchor from a single account fetch.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix timestamp captured at subnet formation (`create_shipment`). Bound
into the genesis chain hash so the exportable hash chain is unique per
shipment from byte one; also a convenience for off-chain accounting.

fields.name: chain_hash
docs: Constant-size cryptographic hash chain committing to the full ordered
history of consensus proofs anchored to this shipment. Initialized at
creation to a domain-separated genesis hash bound to the shipment's
identity, then folded forward on every accepted proof
(`SHA256(prev_chain_hash || proof_commitment || proof_sequence)`).
Provides a constant-size, trivially-queryable on-chain integrity anchor
that lets any party verify the completeness and ordering of proofs
retrieved from the transaction log without trusting the retrieval path.

fields.name: closed
docs: True once the operator has dissolved the subnet. One-way: cannot be
unset. When true, the program rejects new proofs and new assignments.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for re-derivation.

fields.name: attestations
docs: Independent off-chain verification attestations pinned to this
shipment's `chain_hash`. Additive and multi-party: any signer may
attest a closed shipment; downstream consumers choose which verifiers
to trust. Stored inline (rather than per-attestation PDAs) so the full
verification status is readable in a single `getAccountInfo` call.

types.name: ShipmentAttested
docs: Emitted by `attest_shipment_verification`. Records that a verifier has
independently verified the shipment's proof history off-chain. Additive and
multi-party — a shipment may accrue several attestations from distinct
verifiers; downstream consumers choose which verifier(s) to trust.

types.name: ShipmentClosed
docs: Emitted by `close_shipment`. Marks subnet dissolution. Final proof_count
is captured here so an auditor reading just the close transaction's logs
knows the total dispatch count without also fetching the Shipment account.

types.name: ShipmentCreated
docs: Emitted by `create_shipment`. Marks subnet formation.

types.name: VerificationAttestation
docs: A single off-chain verification attestation, stored inline on `Shipment`.
`attestation_signature` is the verifier's signature over the attestation
payload (shipment_pubkey || chain_hash_at_verification || outcome_byte ||
verified_at). It is recorded on-chain so downstream consumers can verify
provenance off-chain; see `attest_shipment_verification` for the (currently
deferred) on-chain ed25519 verification path.

fields.name: verifier
docs: Verifier identity (the attesting signer).

fields.name: verified_at
docs: Unix timestamp the attestation was recorded on-chain.

fields.name: chain_hash_at_verification
docs: The `chain_hash` value the verifier observed when verifying. Pins the
attestation to a specific point in the shipment's proof history.

fields.name: outcome
docs: The recorded verification outcome.

fields.name: attestation_signature
docs: Verifier signature over the attestation payload.

types.name: VerificationOutcome
docs: Outcome a verifier records when attesting a shipment's proof history.
